title: heliotropium ellipticum
intro: Heliotropium ellipticum, commonly known as American heliotrope or false heliotrope, is a perennial plant in the borage family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Heliotropium ellipticum include treating respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The plant contains bioactive constituents like alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is required to fully understand its effects.
